Overview
This epidemiological bulletin aims to provide the situation of key infectious diseases in the WHO South-East Asia region to inform risk assessments and responses. The bulletin uses information from publicly available sources and will be published every two weeks. Key highlights of the bulletin are
Maldives: Measles situation update
WHO/UNICEF Estimates of National Immunization Coverage (WUENIC) 2025
COVID-19, Influenza, mpox, Dengue.
